scope: M07 animation-test runtime path after formal EXE export
observed: Scripted direction input moved the title cursor, proving controller injection works with the Mesen 0.9.9 API order.
With the cursor left on START, the scripted A press was accepted.
The title screen cleared, then the ROM reached GAME OVER with the message 任务失败了，请继续努力！ without showing a battle.
No selected weapon animation was observed.
A verified 8192-byte battery save was recognized by DATA LOAD with three valid slots.
CONTINUE restored the active chapter-26 battle map; scripted input opened the selected ally command menu, weapon list, and range/target-selection layer.
Runtime ROM-read tracing proved that the combatant index at CPU $00BB selects the deployed-unit byte at $741A and that unit ID selects its two-byte weapon table at PRG $B2C8.

The product fixture now clones the verified active-battle save, equips test unit $11 with the editor-selected weapon in the exported ROM, mirrors the deployed-unit and adjacent-enemy changes into the checked backup, and recalculates its checksum.
The generated fixture exposed weapon $01 光束军刀, entered the range/target-selection layer, and reached the combat screen with 亚古特·多加攻击; the original project ROM and source save remained unchanged.
diagnosis: The previous product button exported an ordinary ROM only. The repaired path now creates an isolated ROM/SRAM pair from a checksum-valid active battle, binds the selected weapon through the verified deployed-unit table, and launches that pair in Mesen.
